mapper.select: SELECT term_band_id, term_component_id, band_no, lower_bound, upper_bound, rate, fixed_amount FROM t_commercial_term_component_band WHERE term_component_id IN (SELECT term_component_id FROM t_commercial_term_component WHERE term_price_id IN (SELECT term_price_id FROM t_commercial_term_price WHERE term_version_id IN (SELECT term_version_id FROM t_commercial_term_version WHERE term_plan_id IN (SELECT term_plan_id FROM t_commercial_term_plan WHERE client_id = #{clientId} OR local_partner_id IN (SELECT source_partner_id FROM t_entity_source_relation WHERE entity_no IN (SELECT entity_no FROM t_client_entity_affiliation WHERE client_id = #{clientId}) AND source_type='PARTNER'))) AND entity_no IN (SELECT entity_no FROM t_client_entity_affiliation WHERE client_id = #{clientId}))) ORDER BY term_band_id
